text_block_list.text:
It's the final day of summer camp,<n>and we're
scheduled to return to the<n>academy after lunch.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go get dessert! Anybody<n>else want
some too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Around the Table
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks a lot! Yes please, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Mont Blanc.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What was that, McQueen? Oho?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Are you a big fan of today's dessert?<n>I bet you'd
like to have my Mont<n>Blanc, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What?! I-I couldn't do that! I'm<n>refraining from
such indulgences at<n>present!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To claim the shield in the autumn<n>Tenno Sho, some
sacrifices are<n>necessary!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
To be able to resist something you<n>love like that,
your self-control is<n>amazing, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's because McQueen believes<n>it's the Mejiro
family's responsibility<n>to win the shield.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know... I've been thinking about<n>something
ever since the spring<n>Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Watching you Mejiro princesses has<n>made me
realize how incredible you<n>all are. You've earned
my respect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Say what now?! Me, a "princess"?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's something noble about<n>your
strength... Or maybe it's that you<n>grow stronger for
the sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You never shy away from<n>expectations, and your
efforts inspire<n>all those around you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to find the strength to shoulder<n>the hopes of
everyone who supports<n>me, too. I'd love it if I could
be more<n>like you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's what you meant! Haha.<n>Well, the thing
is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're not a Mejiro, Ines—you're<n>you. So there's
no need for you to<n>carry that kind of burden, is
there?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You saying I can't do it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, no! That's not what I meant!<n>Hmm... How do I
put it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you follow the path that's<n>laid out in
front of you, we'll be able<n>to envision our own
dreams through<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I could picture my dream so vividly<n>when I watched
you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You said something similar to me<n>during the
Derby, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, so you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's what I believe, anyway. You<n>have a different
kind of strength to<n>my own, and I found solace in
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ack! Wh-what am I blabbering on<n>about?! That was
really corny,<n>wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, why are you acting all<n>embarrassed? I
thought that was a<n>really nice thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Anyway, if you want my<n>advice, then I think
you should<n>discuss it directly with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...With my trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I mean, your trainer is your<n>closest fan, after
all. I'm sure that's<n>where your answer's been
hiding all<n>along!
